name: @ondrift/sdk
description: Drift SDK for Node.js. This root manifest exists so `npm install github:ondrift/cloud` resolves — npm cannot install from a subdirectory of a git repository, and the SDK lives in sdk/. The manifest sdk/package.json describes the same code laid out as it appears inside node_modules, which is what the CLI's vendor path copies; this one describes it as it appears at the repository root, which is what npm clones. Two layouts, two manifests.
author: Drift
